title: Content Writing Intern
description:
2Base Technologies is at a deliberate stage of building its marketing content function, and this internship is the entry point into that function.
 



 We are a technology services company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working with mid\-market and enterprise clients across the United States and the United Kingdom. Our work spans custom software development, AI implementation, legacy system modernisation, and operational transformation.
 



 This is an entry\-level writing role with a specific, practical purpose. It is not a social media role and it is not a generalist marketing role. If that distinction is unclear from the outset, this is probably not the right fit.
 



  





**What This Role Exists to Do** 




 Technology is complicated. Our job is to make it clear. This role exists to support the production of written content that explains what 2Base does, what problems we solve, and why that matters to the people we work with. The output is blog posts that earn attention, social copies that are actually read, and supporting content that helps the marketing function move.
 



 You will work from structured briefs, receive direct feedback on every draft, and build a practical foundation in technology content writing. The audience is technical leaders and business decision\-makers at mid\-market companies. Writing that is clear, specific, and free of noise. That is the standard you will be working towards and learning to meet.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* First drafts of blog posts on technology topics including software development, AI implementation, digital transformation, and IT services written from structured briefs provided by the Marketing Manager
* Social media copies for the 2Base LinkedIn page and other channels, produced to brief and reviewed before publishing
* Research for content briefs – gathering background, understanding the topic, and returning with enough substance to write from
* Supporting long\-form content production: contributing sections, drafts, and revisions under direction
* Proofreading and editing your own drafts against 2Base brand voice guidelines before submitting



  





**What You Will Not Own** 



* Content strategy and editorial planning: the Marketing Manager sets the direction and you execute within it
* Publishing decisions: a separate team member manages scheduling and publishing
* Visual design of content assets: the design function owns this
* SEO keyword selection: the SEO specialist sets this and you write within it
* Campaign strategy or audience definition
* Client\-facing communications of any kind



  





**Requirements** 




**Experience** 




  




* Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of experience. Internship experience in content writing, copywriting, journalism, or technical writing counts.
* Has written something anything that demonstrates the ability to put ideas into clear, readable sentences. College submissions, personal blogs, LinkedIn posts, college magazine articles, or internship work all qualify.
* Has used AI writing tools and understands both their value and their limits. AI is a tool in this role, not the writer.
* Background in engineering, computer science, or information technology is preferred. Graduates from other streams with demonstrated interest in technology topics are also considered.



  





**Writing Ability** 



* Writes clearly in English. Not without errors that improves with practice – but with a clear structure and a readable point.
* Can read a brief and produce something that addresses it, rather than writing whatever comes to mind
* Accepts feedback and revises drafts without treating the edit as personal criticism
* Does not pad. Does not repeat the same point in different words to fill length.



  





**Mindset** 



* Genuinely curious about technology topics: not faking interest to get the job, but actually reading and thinking about what software, AI, and digital infrastructure do in the real world
* Comfortable not knowing things and asking questions before writing rather than guessing
* Fast enough to produce a first draft within a day of receiving a brief, knowing it will be edited
* Treats writing as a skill to develop, not a talent they either have or do not have



  





**What We Are Not Looking For** 



* Candidates who cannot write a coherent paragraph in English independently
* Candidates whose primary interest is social media management, graphic design, or video content, who see this as the nearest available opening
* Candidates who use AI tools as the primary author with only light editing and no independent writing ability
* Candidates who expect senior\-level scope, autonomy, or compensation from Day 1
* Candidates who apply without reading the role description and do not include a writing sample



  





**An Honest Note on This Role** 




 This role joins a marketing function that is still building. You will not step into a well\-established content operation. You will work within a documented brand voice and a defined content direction, but the volume, pace, and iteration rhythm are things you will grow into alongside the team.
 



  





 If you want to start a career in technology content writing and you are prepared to put in the work to learn how a B2B technology company communicates with senior buyers, this is a structured entry point. If you are looking for a creative writing role or a social media job, it is not.
 



  





 To apply: send your CV and one writing sample. A blog post, a college article, a LinkedIn post, or anything else you have written that shows us how you think. If you do not have a writing sample, write 200 words on any technology topic that interests you and send it with your application. Send to: talents@2basetechnologies.com
 



  





 Benefits
 



 A growth\-driven environment with opportunities to lead, innovate, and upskill continuously.

title: CBS - BMC - Creative Services - Senior Associate - Senior editor
Publications Coordinator
description:
**Overview** 




 CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events
 



 CACTUS is hiring a publications coordinator on a contractual basis, to support academic researchers and scholarly publishing customers with their various publication and expert\-driven needs.
 



 You will interface directly with multiple technical peers and will be the face of the company to our customers, building and maintaining effective, positive, and professional partnerships. You will be responsible for overseeing projects from start to finish through clear and timely communication and ensure on time delivery and customer satisfaction.
 



  





**Please Note\- This is a contractual opportunity for a period of 6 months.** 




  





**Responsibilities** 



* Develop an excellent partnership with customers and follow through on customer commitments with a strong sense of ownership and integrity.
* Efficiently manage service offerings/packs/projects to deliver superior customer experience. This includes but is limited to tracking progress, deciding appropriate next steps, and coordinating with customers and internal stakeholders effectively.
* Perform quality assurance checks on the project\-specific workflows and additional tasks to ensure quality work and timely delivery
* Analyze, triage, and resolve customer concerns effectively by coordinating with the relevant teams (where needed)
* Contribute effective and well\-written knowledge base articles for all round team improvement and upskilling.



**Qualifications And Prerequisites** 



* Bachelors/Master’s degree in any discipline
* Minimum 1 year of client service and project management experience
* Solid understanding of Microsoft applications, especially excel and power automate
* Excellent professional oral and written English communication skills,strong problem solving skills and drive to provide superior levels of service and expertise
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively within a team with a high\-performance work culture and deadline\-driven goals.
* Experience with CRM tools (Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira etc.)
* Experience in the STEM publishing industry.



 Application Process
 



 Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process starts with a take home assignment, followed by an interview with the hiring managers.
 



**Equal Opportunity** 




 Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
 



**Accelerating from Anywhere** 




 As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.
 


* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.



**About CACTUS** 




 Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI\-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting\-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

title: CBS- BMC-Enablement - Ops Management-Supervising Associate
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Operations Coordinator**
**The opportunity**
 We are looking for a
 **Supervising Associate – Operations Coordinator,** 
 who will be responsible for performing the activities mainly related to Brand \& Marketing (B\&M) operations management and partly project coordination. As part of the B\&M team, you will coordinate with consistent, high\-quality services to key stakeholders across verticals/ business segments.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Issue Resolution: Promptly address operational issues to maintain service excellence and optimize client satisfaction. Understand client needs and ensure that operations align with delivering value to clients
* Relationship Management: Collaborate with key stakeholders and specialist areas to ensure tasks are delivered within agreed timeframes
* Cross\-Departmental Collaboration: Facilitate collaboration to enhance operational efficiency and ensure client\-focused outcomes
* Process Optimization: Analyze and improve business processes for enhanced efficiency and effectiveness
* Data Analysis \& Data Management: Proficiently analyze data to make informed decisions and improve operational performance

* Deployment Activities: Orchestrate deployment activities for various projects
* Workflow Operations: Manage shared mailboxes and oversee ticketing items

* Project Management: Assist in planning, executing, and closing projects, including resource allocation and timeline management

* Risk Management: Promptly identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks
* Web Management: Manage and update EY.com web pages, collaborating with the EY.com team to enhance web presence
* Documentation: Format presentations and decks, and handle SCORE submissions

* Leadership Skills: Demonstrate the ability to motivate colleagues and manage conflicts effectively
* Communication Skills: Exhibit strong verbal and written communication skills for effective collaboration with stakeholders

* Exceptional communication skills \- both written and verbal
* Demonstrate strong organizational skills and critical thinking abilities
* Demonstrate strong interpersonal, analytical skills, problem\-solving and decision\-making skills
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Contribute as an effective team member and take accountability for deliverables

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Overall – 8\-10 years of experience; 4\-5 years of relevant experience
* Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree
* Flexibility to support UK/US time zone
* Experience working with global clients


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Practical experience of working in MS Excel, Word, PPT, Outlook, Teams, PowerBI, SharePoint, OneDrive
* Experience in building ey.com pages preferred
* Knowledge in Project Management concepts and methodologies
* Good understanding of brand, marketing, and communications
* Aptitude and willingness to continually expand your core skillset, including GenAI readiness


**Technologies and Tools**
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PPT)
* Hands on experience with Modern SharePoint Online, Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft OneDrive, ChatGPT/ Co\-Pilot
* Knowledge of Project Management methodologies and tools – Microsoft Project, Trello, Jira,


**What We Look For**
* Self\-motivated individuals with strong desire to learn/ expand their knowledge/ skills/ experiences which fit into changing business environments
* Individual should be capable to prioritise tasks assigned to them with appropriate time management and listening skills
* Ability to build and leverage relationships with and influence multiple internal groups across all levels of the organization
* Ability to quickly define challenges, collect input, conduct assessments, draw conclusions and provide timely recommendations
* Take the initiative; be proactive in a fast\-paced and highly challenging environment
* Efficient team player and ability to demonstrate sound mindset in challenging situations
* Creative problem\-solving mindset with a flexible can\-do attitude
* Flexibility to work during varying shifts, accommodating global time zones

**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy
   

  

 We offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Global Learning & Talent Development Specialist (m/f/d)
description:
**About Us**
 Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward\-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10\.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide.
   

  

 For the better. Together.
   

  

 Are you ready to take the next step in your career? As a Global Talent and Organization Development Senior (m/f/d) at Hellmann Worldwide Logistics, you will play a key role in shaping our global HR landscape. This position offers a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting HR transformation journey—where you take ownership, drive innovation, and collaborate with a team of passionate professionals.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Learning strategy and capability building
   

  

* Develop and deliver a global learning and capability\-building strategy aligned with business priorities and our people strategy.
* Run learning needs analyses and identify capability gaps across functions, regions and talent groups.
* Build capability frameworks and learning roadmaps that support organizational growth and transformation.
* Translate business requirements into practical, sustainable learning solutions.


 Learning design and development
   

  

* Design, develop and continuously improve learning solutions for classroom, virtual, hybrid and self\-paced digital formats.
* Create facilitator guides, participant materials, toolkits, assessments, videos, e\-learning modules and blended programs.
* Apply modern instructional design methods and adult learning principles to keep learning engaging and effective.
* Keep content scalable, learner\-centered and globally relevant, while allowing for local adaptation.


 Talent and leadership development
   

  

* Design and manage global talent and leadership development programs, including offers for emerging leaders, high potentials and critical talent groups.
* Build career development pathways and learning journeys that support career growth and internal mobility.
* Partner with stakeholders on succession\-related development and targeted capability building.
* Support onboarding, upskilling and reskilling as part of an integrated talent approach.


 Organizational development
   

  

* Contribute to organizational development work such as capability modeling, role architecture and organizational effectiveness.
* Support the design of career frameworks and organizational capability assessments.
* Bring a learning lens to change and transformation initiatives.


 Learning technology and measurement
   

  

* Work with our HRIS and technology teams to make the most of our learning management system and other learning technologies.
* Manage learning content deployment, learner experience, reporting and analytics.
* Measure learning effectiveness through data, feedback and business impact, and act on what you find.
* Track external trends and emerging technologies to keep our learning ecosystem current.


**About You**
 Must\-have
   

  

* At least five years of experience in learning and development, talent development, instructional design or a related field.
* Experience designing and delivering global learning and talent programs in a multinational organization.
* A track record of building learning solutions across classroom, virtual, hybrid and digital channels.
* Experience designing leadership development or talent acceleration programs.
* Experience building learning journeys, development pathways or career frameworks.
* Experience working with a learning management system.
* Strong knowledge of instructional design methods, for example ADDIE, SAM, design thinking or learning experience design, and a solid grounding in adult learning theory.
* A degree in HR, organizational psychology, education, learning sciences, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Excellent communication and storytelling, strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, and a global, intercultural mindset.
* The ability to balance strategic work with hands\-on execution.


 Nice\-to\-have
   

  

* Certification in instructional design, learning experience design, adult learning, facilitation, coaching or leadership development.
* Familiarity with learning analytics and evaluation frameworks such as Kirkpatrick.
* Experience with AI\-enabled learning solutions and adaptive learning platforms.
* Experience developing large\-scale global leadership academies or enterprise reskilling initiatives.
* Knowledge of organizational design, workforce planning or change management methodologies.
* Familiarity with skills\-based talent management and career architecture frameworks.
* Additional language skills beyond English.


**How You Work**
 We are looking for someone whose way of working reflects our values:
   

  

* Caring. You build trusted relationships, listen well and keep learners and colleagues at the center of what you design.
* Entrepreneurial. You take ownership, show initiative and stay focused on the impact your work has on the business.
* Forward\-Thinking. You bring curiosity and a digital mindset, and you keep improving how we learn and develop.
* Reliable. You deliver quality work on time, follow through on commitments and measure whether it worked.


 Inclusion and social diversity are firmly anchored values in our corporate culture. Regardless of gender, age, any disabilities, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity: We are looking forward to meeting you!
   

  

 If you are excited by this fantastic opportunity and have what it takes, then click APPLY!
